text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Yamanin Zephyr—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you like the rain?
When one thinks of Yamanin Zephyr, they think of the wind, so hearing her talk about rain is unusual. With that thought, I looked up at the sky—

...It's raining. It's still light right now,
but it looks like it's going to start pouring soon.
choice_data_list: Let's find somewhere to wait out the rain!

text_block_list.text:
It would be terrible if she caught a cold.
I hurried Yamanin Zephyr along and
ran toward a nearby building... but then.
When I look back, Yamanin Zephyr is nowhere to be seen.
Looking around, I saw Yamanin Zephyr gazing at a movie poster featuring sparrows, wild boar piglets, and other forest animals.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The plump one and the chubby one in the picture.
I wonder if I'll ever be able to meet the real ones?

It was like an experiential movie.
With the wind blowing, rain falling, and seats shaking... it supposedly let you experience being inside the film.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It feels as though I have been touched by the morning breeze.
An unfamiliar wind is here.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind and rain in the sky feel pleasant,
and my heart finds calm in them, yet
I suppose this is not the world as it should be.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I want to feel it. The unknown wind.

It seemed she wanted to experience this movie.
Seeing Yamanin Zephyr about to go alone, I stopped her and asked if we could go together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My, thank you very much.
Like a gentle southern breeze, you do not let my words simply blow past you without heed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. My heart is dancing, light and airy.
As if bathed in the spring flower winds.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The oppressive pressure felt from deep inside is just like the nightfall.
To the current me, it is no different from a gentle breeze.
Now, let us go."
Together with a slightly restless Yamanin Zephyr, who seemed a bit different from usual, I moved into the theater.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: La la~ lu, la la la~♪

"A young girl lost in the forest, interacting with wild animals.
The movie was a heartwarming story made for children."

The wind blew, rain poured, a storm brewed—
Overcoming it through cooperation,
in the end, the girl played a tune, and the animals sang.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The round one had a song of the fair breeze.
The plump one danced the dance of the gusting wind.
Yes, they were quite adorable.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The maiden's melody is like a gentle spring breeze.
...Lu-lu~ Ah-ah~♪"
choice_data_list: Could you get a good feel for the wind and rain?
Whoa, the chair really shook, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No. In an enclosed space like this,
the heavenly breeze cannot reach us.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If something shrouds the heavens, blessings too shall fall.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, yes. Even if drowned out by voices
and chatter, it does not matter.
Let us head outside.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The singing, the dancing, the melody—
they were all quite lovely.
However, I prefer the genuine article.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you like the rain?

Asking the same question as before,
Yamanin Zephyr stepped outside.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I like it.
The gentle drizzle, the pouring rain.
It feels as though I'm melting into the sound."

Watching her stand in the rain, getting soaked
seemed like something that was simply meant to be accepted,
and no words of objection came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even if we will one day become a raging gale,
for now, let us walk together through the rain
like a gentle breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
âSee, it feels so pleasant.
Breathe in, and reach your hands out wide.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Like wrapping myself in purifying rain
and a blessed breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Rattling and shaking more and more.
It's completely different from when the fierce wind struck my back...
My body hurts a little.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. But the 'sensory feedback' is plenty.
After all, the round ones aren't perching on my shoulders, and the plump ones aren't sitting on my lap."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm really starting to miss them.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Has the rain stopped, I wonder?
Let us sing together, dance together.
Allow me to carry the melody upon the wind in her stead.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't matter if it's still raining.
The rain will eventually stop, and it's a blessing from the heavens, after all."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Lulu-lee, lala-loo~♪
Mr. Plump and Mr. Tender,
I'm coming for you now~.

I hurriedly ran after Yamanin Zephyr,
who had begun drifting aimlessly into the rain.
